notes.title: Year-End Recap & Important Updates For Our Snowcastle Community
notes.content:
Hello there, Adventurers! 🌱

As we approach the end of the year, it's time to reflect on the milestones we've achieved together and share some important updates.

🎉 Ikonei Island Launched on Steam and Epic

We're thrilled to announce the successful launch of Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure on November 9th, now available on both Steam and Epic platforms. We worked hard to implement the “Friends’ Pass”, which also functions as a demo! The “Friends’ Pass” allows a group of up to 4 players to play indefinitely on the host’s island, provided the host owns the game. We hope this fosters a sense of community and collaboration among players. 

We are not done with Ikonei Island yet - On December 14th, Ikonei is celebrating “Lystide”!
Players will be visited by “The Spirit of Lystide Past” - so make sure to check out the Hamlet!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/a169e38a74f42c826116f329d5bceb46bdcf3c7b.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/06cbfd70ed93f37d1bf4d5f12b679ce47a271211.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/5649d99f731ff81f3590bc70725da6e6e051ef74.png
Lystide sneak peeks!
[hr][/hr]
Your support has been instrumental in making this launch a success, and we're excited to continue building and expanding Ikonei Island in the coming months.

🌱 Earthlock's Epic Store Free Week

Our first title, Earthlock, was originally released in 2018. We have seen a huge boost in activity since it was available for free on the Epic Store for a week in November. Over 5.9 million people claimed the game! We hope you enjoyed revisiting the world of Earthlock. Be sure to check out our comics on Steam and Epic if you want to delve further into the Earthlock lore.

🏜️ Earthlock 2 Delay and Updates

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/edf30162d71cd0e1985c189d0cacde7ca2245b16.png

We have restarted the Earthlock 2 project and with that put the date to TBA. For the last year, we have been in pre-production totally redesigning the main concept and direction of the game. We are super excited to share this new vision for E2 with you and will be doing so in the upcoming months.

Our team made the choice to switch from Unity to Unreal Engine a couple of years ago. This has been a huge undertaking, and we have learned a lot about the engine, and the way we work as a studio. Another major challenge we have taken on is working on our first multiplayer game in Ikonei Island. We have grown as a studio tackling these challenges, but it has cost us more time than initially anticipated.

However, for the last year, we have gone back to pre-production working on the core vision, and redesigned the main concept for the game. We feel we have something really good now, and we have been presenting this to publishers and investors lately. We even won an award for the most anticipated game at an investor event in Malta at the end of November. 

We are working on making this vision presentable to the community and will begin posting about this soon. We’re excited to share these new features and more news about the development process going forward, so wishlist Earthlock 2 to keep up to date!

Speaking of new features… What’s this? 

[previewyoutube=p-7ranLvh98;full][/previewyoutube]

As we wrap up the year, we want to express our gratitude for your unwavering support, feedback, and enthusiasm. Our community plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of our games, and we look forward to embarking on new adventures together in the upcoming year. 

Wishing you a joyful holiday season and a fantastic New Year filled with exciting gaming experiences!

[hr][/hr]
💙 Join Our Discord Island

Join our community on Discord! We've got contests, and channels where you can share feedback, report bugs, get help with the game, and find friends to play with. Aside from the magnanimous presence of your favorite Frogboy!

And please consider wishlisting Earthlock 2! It's the best way you can support Snowcastle and our next project right now (updates + adjusted release date coming to the page soon) ♥

https://store.steampowered.com/app/826640/EARTHLOCK_2/


We'll see you at the Lystide event! Check out the central area of Ikonei Island on December 14th 🎄
Snowcastle Games

Hello There, Heroes!

We are excited to announce that we are supporting WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation for World Oceans Day!

The WDC World Oceans Day Sale starts today and runs until 15th June, 10 AM PDT, and you can save a fin-tastic 80% off EARTHLOCK!

We will also donate 20% of our net profits to WDC to support their conservation work.* 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/761030/EARTHLOCK/

WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection and conservation of whales and dolphins. 
Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across the whole spectrum of threats, from climate breakdown to accidental entanglements in fishing gear. They bring together and work hand-in-hand with, businesses, philanthropists, scientists, NGOs, governments, and grassroots communities to find solutions to the problems faced by whales and dolphins.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/97227c1718bf3b96597588759f6f1484e7f01289.png
Their aim is to reverse the global decline in whale and dolphin populations by:

 Stopping cruelty from deliberate harms such as whaling and captivity.
 Creating safe seas, free from the threat of pollution, collisions with vessels, and accidental entanglement in fishing gear.
 Winning recognition of whales and dolphins as sentient, socially complex beings, and our allies in the fight against climate and nature breakdown.

Whales and dolphins are awe-inspiring. They are intelligent beings, vital for the health of the ocean and planet. They have suffered from terrible harm - deliberate and accidental - and their homes and populations are under threat. But it's not too late. 
Together we can still help them recover and flourish and they can help us reconnect with the wild, and repair the damage we have caused.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/a77f8f3252bb0bc81e862f5430d183a82e867325.png

notes.title: Announcing a new game - Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure!
notes.content:
Exciting Announcement from Snowcastle Games!

Last time we told you that we have a secret project that we will tell you about soon, and here we are! We are happy to announce our new, upcoming game Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure! Ikonei Island will be an early access game coming soon to PC, and eventually make its way to consoles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/8d732d9a6e777483d0262bf458a3a9229a1a2e0b.png

Taking inspiration from titles like Animal Crossing and Stardew Valley, Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure offers a unique take on the genre, adding to compelling resource gathering and crafting systems with perilous pirate camps, the ability to enlist the unique talents of the island’s wildlife to help you out and many more exciting additions to be announced as we lay out the roadmap for Ikonei Island’s early access journey.

Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure builds on the success of the Earthlock RPGs, taking the rich world-building and magical setting of the franchise into new territory. Set on a deserted island, the game tasks players with exploring its diverse and intriguing landscape as they collect resources for crafting and befriend wildlife to employ their unique abilities to progress to new areas of the island. 

You will discover ancient ruins from a bygone civilization, deal with treasure-hungry pirates, and unlock a host of different biomes, ranging from icy mountains and parched deserts, to dense jungles and humid swamps, as you uncover the secrets the island has to offer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/7223cd584ce1f72cdab31d17927fca169be07ae9.png

You will also have the opportunity to make the island your own. An upgradable hamlet serves as a base of operations and unique placeable items allow you to customize the island to your liking! 

There’s a lot more to learn about the game’s intriguing environments and expansive web of gameplay systems. Your feedback will be vital in informing the tweaks and additions made to the game during its time in early access, so you are encouraged to join our Discord  and get involved in helping to shape Ikonei Island.

You can wishlist Ikonei Island: An Earthlock Adventure on Steam now!

To be the first to hear about Snowcastle news subscribe to our newsletter.

notes.title: Earthlock 2 Update!
notes.content:
Hello from Umbra and our Snowcastle team!

We have been awfully quiet about Earthlock 2, and we are sure you are wondering what is happening. 👀 
Rest assured, Earthlock 2 is coming! 

But before we update you on Earthlock 2, we want to tell you about our studio and what we have been up to. 

First, we want to thank you for your continued support! Our fans keep messaging and tweeting us about our games and asking about our team - it means the world to us! 

What has Snowcastle Games been up to last year?

We have some bad news and some good news. The bad news is that, unfortunately, Earthlock 2 is delayed and will not be released this year. Don’t worry, we are still working on it! Since we began the game, our team has doubled and we have had to come to grips with switching from Unity to Unreal. This has been a huge undertaking, and we realized that we needed to rethink how we work. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/c0674db76aab08987f1c11e89fc5931e5c2ccf6a.png
Earthlock 2 Character Concept Art

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31520203/4416275c9868ae5e65d0bea3552d2cd1c1b7c86d.png
Earthlock 2 In Engine capture

The good news is that the changes we’ve made internally have been a huge success! Earthlock 2 is an ambitious project. We know you have high hopes for it and so do we. Now we are confident that we’re on the right road to meeting those expectations.

There is, however, one last thing: beside Earthlock 2, we have been working on something that you are going to hear about very soon! 🤩 It is a completely new project and we can’t wait to show it!

We hope you continue to support us, and promise to share updates a lot more frequently in the future, both about Earthlock 2 and our secret new project! Subscribe to our newsletter here: https://www.snowcastlegames.com/newsletter
